units: <cite ref="Shabbat 31a:1">Sabb. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>ויצא לִקְרָאתוֹ</he> and came out to meet him.
<cite ref="Shabbat 119a">Ib. 119ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 32a">B. Kam. 32ᵃ</cite> top <he>לקראת כלה</he> to meet the bride (the Sabbath); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to meet, join, esp. נִקְרֵי, נִיקְרֵי (denom. of קֶרִי) to lose semen.
units: Gen. R. s. 52; s. 74, a. e. אין הלשון הזה וַיִּקָּר אלא לשון טומאה this expression vayiḳḳar (Num. XXIII, 4) has the meaning of uncleanness (by analogy from Deut. XXIII, 11).—

senses.gloss: same, to have (nocturnal) pollution; to lose semen. Y. Snh. II, 20ᵇ top; Midr. Sam. ch. XXIII (ref. to I Sam. XXV, 20) ותפגש אותם הוּקְרוּ כולן ‘she struck them’ (with her charms), all of them met with &c.
